% Flux Jacobian in the x-direction
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3-Ax-def}
A_x(\mathbf{U}) \;\equiv\; \frac{\partial \mathbf{F}_x}{\partial \mathbf{U}}
\end{equation}

% Characteristic polynomial
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3-charpoly}
\det(A_x - \lambda I) \;=\; (u - \lambda)^{2}\bigl[(u - \lambda)^{2} - c^{2}\bigr], \qquad c = \sqrt{\gamma p / \rho}
\end{equation}

% Eigenvalues
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3-eigvals}
\{\lambda_k\}_{k=0}^{3} \;=\; \{\,u - c,\ u,\ u,\ u + c\,\}
\end{equation}

% Right eigenvectors (columns of R)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3-right-eigvecs}
R_0 \;=\; \begin{pmatrix}1\\ u - c\\ v\\ h - u\,c\end{pmatrix},\quad R_1 \;=\; \begin{pmatrix}1\\ u\\ v\\ \tfrac{1}{2}(u^{2}+v^{2})\end{pmatrix},\quad R_2 \;=\; \begin{pmatrix}0\\ 0\\ 1\\ v\end{pmatrix},\quad R_3 \;=\; \begin{pmatrix}1\\ u + c\\ v\\ h + u\,c\end{pmatrix}
\end{equation}

% Specific total enthalpy (appears in acoustic eigenvectors)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3-enthalpy}
h \;=\; \frac{\gamma\,p}{(\gamma - 1)\,\rho} + \tfrac{1}{2}(u^{2} + v^{2})
\end{equation}

% Characteristic decomposition
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3-diagonalisation}
A_x \;=\; R\,\mathrm{diag}(u - c,\ u,\ u,\ u + c)\,L, \qquad L = R^{-1}
\end{equation}

% Two-fold degeneracy at lambda = u
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A3-degeneracy}
R_1\ \text{and}\ R_2\ \text{both satisfy}\ A_x R_k = u\,R_k; \ R_1\ \text{carries density contrast (entropy), }\ R_2\ \text{carries tangential velocity (shear)}
\end{equation}
